name: FIREBENCH
intro: FIREBENCH面向企业与API场景评估六类精确指令遵循能力：输出格式、顺序回复、条目排序、过度自信、正向内容要求和负向内容要求。论文Table 1给出2,470条样本，并按类别使用程序验证、简单模糊匹配或GPT-4.1准则评判。
build_method: 六类企业能力池组装, 程序化真值构造, GPT-5内容准则生成
task_type: 指令遵循, 信息抽取, 客服, 代码代理
eval_feature: 企业场景, 格式约束, API驱动
intro_en: FIREBENCH evaluates six precise instruction-following capabilities for enterprise and API settings: output format, ordered responses, item ranking, overconfidence, positive content requirements, and negative content requirements. Paper Table 1 contains 2,470 samples graded by programmatic checks, simple fuzzy matching, or GPT-4.1 rubrics depending on category.
build_method_en: Six Enterprise Capability Pools, Programmatic Ground-truth Construction, GPT-5 Content-rubric Generation
task_type_en: Instruction Following, Information Extraction, Customer Support, Coding Agents
eval_feature_en: Enterprise Scenarios, Format Constraints, API-driven Evaluation

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.04857v1 Sections 3.1-3.6 and Table 1, plus the official FireBench repository at dad399d938385ab798952b76f2690522d6cd59c6. The paper composition is 2,470: output format 1,300; ordered responses 200; item ranking 200; overconfidence 370; positive content 200; negative content 200. Output-format QA says 25 questions from each of LongBench V2, QUALITY, GPQA Diamond and LogiQA under 21 constraints, yet reports 1,000 QA instances; 100 times 21 is 2,100, so the diagram preserves the paper's stated 1,000 and Table 1 total and flags the inconsistency. MHPP contributes 100 problems under three formats. Ordered support trials collect 10-15 fields one per turn from about 70 fields with 5-10 vetted values each; ranking uses 20 tables and exact rows; overconfidence combines 300 paired normal/uncertainty trials with about 70 unanswerable documents. GPT-5 generates positive and negative rubrics over the same 200 Arena Hard Auto 2.0 prompts, and GPT-4.1 judges whether every rubric is satisfied. The paper reports six category accuracies and their unweighted mean. At the pinned public commit, the four QA files contain 12 examples each (48 times 21 equals 1,008), main.py averages seven test-set scores rather than six category means, and the content-requirement implementation calls the tested model instead of judge_model; these release-harness differences are documented and not silently presented as the paper protocol.
